notes.proposed: Sparse-state reconstruction + differentiable continuous MPC with site-wise calibrated safety.
notes.native_rules: Frozen SWMM [CONTROLS] with no Python actuator overrides.
notes.passive_no_rtc: Same physical network with [CONTROLS] removed; this is not all-open.
notes.hold: Freeze actuator readback at the first control decision and hold it.
notes.all_open: Diagnostic constant setting=1.0 for every eligible continuous actuator.
notes.all_closed: Diagnostic constant setting=0.0 for every eligible continuous actuator.
